### accounting

| `map-gl-accounts` | Map GL Accounts to the Chart of Accounts | Map SKU.io's accounting roles (sales, COGS, inventory, AR, AP, sales tax and more) to the customer's QuickBooks Online or Xero accounts, and save only after explicit approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Map GL accounts" step or when journals fail for a missing nominal code mapping. | accounting:read, settings:read, settings:write |
| `map-product-accounts` | Map Product Accounts with Account Rules | Turn a customer's per-product GL spreadsheet into a few SKU.io account rules (by category, brand, supplier or product type), keep true exceptions as product overrides, and save only after explicit approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Map GL accounts" step or a product GL sheet. | accounting:read, accounting:write, products:read, products:write |
| `reconcile-supplier-statement` | Reconcile a Supplier Statement | Reconcile a supplier's statement and the bank payments to them against SKU.io's bills, credits and payments, explain every difference, and fix the SKU.io side with approval. Use for "does our statement from X match", "why does SKU.io say we owe X more", or a regular supplier reconciliation. | suppliers:read, purchase-orders:read, purchase-orders:write, accounting:read, accounting:write, settings:read |
| `record-vendor-credit` | Record a Vendor Credit | Record a supplier credit memo (vendor credit, credit note) from the PDF or email and apply it to the open bill it reduces. For non-inventory credits such as co-op or advertising credits, rebates, allowances and overbilling. Returned goods and PO price corrections are routed elsewhere. | accounting:read, accounting:write, purchase-orders:read, suppliers:read, settings:read |

### inventory

| `adjust-inventory` | Adjust Inventory | Adjust the on-hand quantity of a product at a warehouse in SKU.io — an increase, a decrease, or a set-to-value. Use this for stock takes, corrections, damage/shrinkage write-offs, or found stock. For later counts or corrections use adjust-inventory. | inventory:read, inventory:write, warehouses:read, settings:write, products:read |

### products

| Skill | Title | Description | Scopes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `build-product-catalog` | Build a Product Catalog from Any Source | Import products into SKU.io from a spreadsheet, CSV, Google Sheet, supplier price list, web page or pasted text: map the fields, de-duplicate against the catalog, then create them. Use to onboard a new catalog, import a supplier's range, or bulk-load products from another system. | products:write, products:read |
| `configure-bundles` | Configure Bundles and Kits | Add components to bundle and kit products that have none, from the user's component sheet or the channel listing titles, after approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Configure kits & bundles" step, after importing multi-pack or set listings, or when kits or bundles show no components. | products:read, products:write |
| `enrich-channel-content` | Enrich Product Content for a Sales Channel | Write the channel-specific product descriptions a marketplace needs (e.g. tiktokshop_description) from existing copy, with an HTML review report; only approved copy is saved. Use when products can't list on TikTok Shop, Walmart or Temu because descriptions are missing or break channel rules. | products:read, products:write, suppliers:read |
| `find-matrix-opportunities` | Find Matrix (Variant) Product Opportunities | Find standalone products that are really one product in several sizes, colours or styles, check them against Amazon variation data, and optionally group them into matrix (variant) products. Use when asked which products should be variants, or why size/colour products are listed one by one. | products:read, products:write, integrations:read |
| `find-product` | Find a Product | Look up a product in the SKU.io catalog by SKU, barcode, or a free-text search over name and SKU. Use this whenever you need to resolve a product reference to its SKU.io product record and id — for example before adding it to a sales order, checking stock, or reporting on it. | products:read |
| `map-supplier-costs` | Map Supplier Costs onto Reorderable Products | Fill in missing supplier costs for reorderable products from the user's supplier price lists or past purchase orders, after approval. Use for the Launch Roadmap's "Supplier costs" step or products with no supplier pricing. For a new price file on products that have costs, use update-catalog-pricing. | products:read, products:write, suppliers:read, purchase-orders:read |
| `publish-listing` | Publish or Update a Channel Listing | List a product on a sales channel (Amazon, eBay, Walmart, Shopify, BigCommerce, WooCommerce, TikTok Shop, Temu, Faire) or revise a live listing: pick the category, map required fields, validate, publish and follow the result. Use whenever a product should be listed, re-listed or its listing updated. | products:read, products:write |
| `update-catalog-pricing` | Update Catalog Pricing from a Price File | Apply a new price file to existing products: match rows by SKU, supplier SKU, MPN or barcode, show old vs new, confirm, then update supplier costs and/or selling prices. Use when a supplier sends new pricing or a range is repriced. Never creates products (that is build-product-catalog). | products:read, products:write, suppliers:read |
